name: Serenity Yenrai
source:
Serenity Yenrai is the daughter of a political dynasty, though it seems her family will never let her gain real power. Serenity is on the board of a children's benefit and a foundation for the arts and isn't shy about leveraging her family's resources to support the charities. 
[From [url=https://teamotomegamejam.itch.io/the-algernon-affair]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Serenity Yenrai is the daughter of a political dynasty, though it seems her family will never let her gain real power. Serenity is on the board of a children's benefit and a foundation for the arts and isn't shy about leveraging her family's resources to support the charities.
